warnings.message: One supplied Love & Bravery file is byte-identical to a KFC capture. It was excluded from the clean asset library, so Love & Bravery has one unique reference photo.
Setirom and Seorae have no unit number in the source list.
No capture-role assignment was guessed. Each store's available photos remain usable as vision/location references.
Exact Hallway/Turn-to-store boundaries remain intentionally blank; route media is fully sequenced but not yet edge-bound.
Cross-floor topology is now based on the team-provided Connector A–G descriptions. Walking times and exact map coordinates are still unmeasured, so shortest paths use logical navigation weights.
